description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogItem endpoints of the Public API in the eShopOnWeb project. It verifies listing, pagination, and parallel API calls.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: Unit tests class for catalog item listing endpoints, checking successful data retrieval and pagination behavior.

methods.name: ReturnsFirst10CatalogItems
methods.description: Verifies that requesting page size 10 returns exactly 10 catalog items.

methods.name: ReturnsCorrectCatalogItemsGivenPageIndex1
methods.description: Checks that pagination with pageSize and pageIndex returns the expected number of catalog items.

methods.name: SuccessFullMutipleParallelCall
methods.description: Performs multiple parallel GET requests to various endpoints to verify they all succeed with HTTP 200 OK.
